Headless curation

Source: vignettes/headless-curation.Rmd
headless-curation.Rmd

Headless curation runs the whole pipeline from a script. It queries the CompTox dashboard, so the code in this vignette is shown but not executed.

One call 

library(concert)

out <- curate_headless(
  input_path = "data/inventory.xlsx",
  output_path = "output/inventory_curated.xlsx",
  tag_map = list(
    chemical_name = "Name",
    cas_number = "CASRN",
    result = "Result",
    unit = "Unit"
  )
)

tag_map keys are column names after janitor::clean_names(), so "CAS Number" becomes cas_number. Run suggest_column_tags() on the cleaned names if you are unsure (see vignette("cleaning-pipeline")).

The output workbook has one sheet per pipeline stage: cleaned data, resolution state, cleaning audit, consensus summary, and a Pipeline Config sheet that lets the app or parse_concert_export() reload the run.

The return value mirrors the workbook:

out$data          # one row per input row, with dtxsid, preferred name, and status
out$audit_trail   # every cleaning change

Set write_files = FALSE to get the same list without touching disk.

Useful options

Argument Use it when
header_row Frontmatter detection picked the wrong row.
value_corrections A prefix, suffix, or typo affects many rows. Applied before cleaning.
cleaning_steps A cleaning step mangles this dataset. list(chiral = FALSE) and so on.
postprocess_candidates You want the same enrichment, scoring, and auto-resolve pass as the app.
accept_suggestions Accept every candidate scored suggested after postprocessing.
review_picks You know the right DTXSID for specific names. Validated against CompTox.
row_flags Mark rows FOLLOW-UP, BAD, or VERIFIED with a reason.
multi_analyte_resolutions Split, keep, or rename cells like "Lead + Zinc".
harmonize, media, format Parse results, convert units, and write ToxVal parquet or CSV.
starts_with Allow a CompTox starts-with fallback for names nothing else matched.

Review inputs are content-keyed. A review_picks row matches on the cleaned name (and casrn when given), never on row position, so decisions survive re-runs after upstream corrections change the row order.

out <- curate_headless(
  input_path = "data/inventory.xlsx",
  output_path = "output/inventory_curated.xlsx",
  tag_map = list(chemical_name = "Name", cas_number = "CASRN"),
  postprocess_candidates = TRUE,
  accept_suggestions = TRUE,
  review_picks = data.frame(
    name = "TKN",
    dtxsid = "DTXSID0020000"
  ),
  row_flags = data.frame(
    name = "Total PFAS",
    flag = "FOLLOW-UP",
    reason = "Group total, no single DTXSID"
  ),
  value_corrections = data.frame(
    column = "chemical_name",
    pattern = "^Dissolved ",
    replacement = ""
  )
)

Stages

curate_headless() is a composition of six stage functions. Call them yourself when you want to stop partway, inspect state, or swap a step.

state <- stage_ingest(input_path = "data/inventory.xlsx", tag_map = tag_map)
state <- stage_clean(state)
state$cleaning_result$audit_trail

state <- stage_curate(state)
state$consensus_summary

state <- stage_review(state, accept_suggestions = TRUE)
state <- stage_harmonize(state, harmonize = TRUE)
stage_export(state, output_path = "output/inventory_curated.xlsx")

Each stage adds fields to the same state list. The header comment in R/curate_stages.R lists them.

Replay scripts

generate_concert_script() writes a standalone script that reproduces a run with one curate_headless() call. It embeds every decision plus compact snapshots of the reference lists, unit map, and media map, so the replay is pinned even after package defaults change.

script <- generate_concert_script(
  input_path = "data/inventory.xlsx",
  output_path = "output/inventory_curated.xlsx",
  tag_map = tag_map,
  header_row = state$detection$header_row,
  reference_lists = state$reference_lists,
  accept_suggestions = TRUE,
  review_picks = data.frame(name = "TKN", dtxsid = "DTXSID0020000")
)
writeLines(script, "output/replay.R")

The app’s export does the same from the Review Results tab, and the agent loop below writes one on every run. Commit replay.R with the data. It is the reproducibility record.

Agent loop

For unattended curation, the package ships a decide-run-inspect loop. An agent (or you) edits one file, decisions.R, and re-runs until no row is pending.

curate_decisions_template("data/inventory.xlsx", out_dir = "output/loop")

This writes output/loop/decisions.R with the detected header row, suggested tags, a pinned reference-list snapshot, and a commented schema for every other decision object. Then:

curate_iterate("output/loop/decisions.R")

Each run writes:

  • status.md: done or not, errors, unmatched decision keys, and a list of low-similarity matches that deserve a second look.
  • pending.csv: one row per unresolved data row with a pending_type (multi_analyte, disagree, suggested, no_match), the suggested DTXSID or split, and the candidate list.
  • replay.R: the standalone reproduction script.
  • cache/: CompTox search results, so re-runs only re-query changed names.

Resolve pending rows by adding to the decision objects in decisions.R (review_picks, row_flags, multi_analyte_resolutions, value_corrections, cleaning_steps, reference-list overrides), then re-run. Root-cause fixes that clear many rows beat per-row picks.

A command-line runner and an agent skill document the same loop:

system.file("scripts/curate_loop.R", package = "concert")
system.file("skills/concert-curate/SKILL.md", package = "concert")
Rscript <runner> --template input.csv output/loop
Rscript <runner> output/loop/decisions.R   # exit 0 = done, exit 2 = rows pending
